title: Law to alert public when ambulance dispatches are backlogged
summary: This bill would require New York City Emergency Management to issue public alerts whenever the Fire Department has more than 25 pending ambulance dispatches at once. The alerts would share information on non-emergency medical care options and when people might need to seek alternative transportation to an emergency room. Notifications would be limited to once per hour, and the law would take effect 90 days after passage.
